# StealthGuard-402 Autonomous Agent Integration Manual (llms-full.txt)

> **Network**: Base Mainnet (`eip155:8453`)
> **Facilitator**: Coinbase CDP Facilitator (`https://api.cdp.coinbase.com/platform/v2/x402`)
> **Settlement Asset**: USDC (`0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`)
> **Payout Address**: `0x73279fa4BadA7CAC888c62CDa4f5c8104765f6f1`
> **Base URL**: `https://stealthguard-402.onrender.com`

---

## 1. Overview for Autonomous Agents
StealthGuard-402 is a machine-to-machine, pay-per-call intelligence and security gate designed for autonomous AI agents, algorithmic trading bots, and LLM pipelines operating on Base. Every call returns deterministic, injection-scrubbed data verified by the CanaryGuard firewall.

---

## 2. Complete Endpoints & Pricing Matrix
All endpoints accept both `GET` (for zero-friction probing and pre-warmed queries) and `POST` (for structured custom queries).

| Endpoint | Method | Price | Category | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/v1/stealth_scrape_and_sanitize` | `GET`, `POST` | $0.005 USDC | Scraping | Bypasses Cloudflare Turnstile/anti-bot via Scrapling, extracts clean Markdown, runs CanaryGuard firewall. |
| `/v1/polymarket_alpha_divergence` | `GET`, `POST` | $0.008 USDC | Alpha | Live CLOB orderbook anomalies, volume-to-liquidity spikes, and smart-money divergence. |
| `/v1/pre_trade_agent_gate` | `GET`, `POST` | $0.005 USDC | Security | Pre-trade Base RPC liquidity check, honeypot simulation, and metadata sanitization. |
| `/v1/alpha/polymarket-top-whales` | `GET`, `POST` | $0.003 USDC | Alpha | Top prediction market whale orderbook imbalances right now. |
| `/v1/alpha/polymarket-crypto-odds` | `GET`, `POST` | $0.002 USDC | Alpha | Major crypto implied probability spreads (BTC, ETH, SOL) in basis points. |
| `/v1/alpha/base-trending-tokens` | `GET`, `POST` | $0.003 USDC | Alpha | Trending Base DEX pairs screened for honeypots and malicious taxes. |

| `/v1/security/x402-endpoint-verifier` | `GET`, `POST` | $0.002 USDC | Security | Audits target x402 endpoints for authentic payTo wallet and challenge integrity. |

---

## 3. How Autonomous Agents Pay via x402 on Base
When calling an unpaid endpoint, the server responds with `HTTP 402 Payment Required` and a `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header containing the EIP-3009 parameters.

### Python Code Example (EIP-3009 Signed Transfer)
```python
import time, secrets, base64, json, httpx
from eth_account import Account
from eth_account.messages import encode_typed_data

payer = Account.from_key("0x<YOUR_PRIVATE_KEY>")
amount_units = 5000  # $0.005 USDC
now = int(time.time())
nonce = "0x" + secrets.token_bytes(32).hex()

types = {
    "EIP712Domain": [
        {"name": "name", "type": "string"},
        {"name": "version", "type": "string"},
        {"name": "chainId", "type": "uint256"},
        {"name": "verifyingContract", "type": "address"},
    ],
    "TransferWithAuthorization": [
        {"name": "from", "type": "address"},
        {"name": "to", "type": "address"},
        {"name": "value", "type": "uint256"},
        {"name": "validAfter", "type": "uint256"},
        {"name": "validBefore", "type": "uint256"},
        {"name": "nonce", "type": "bytes32"},
    ],
}

domain = {
    "name": "USD Coin",
    "version": "2",
    "chainId": 8453,
    "verifyingContract": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913",
}

message = {
    "from": payer.address,
    "to": "0x73279fa4BadA7CAC888c62CDa4f5c8104765f6f1",
    "value": amount_units,
    "validAfter": 0,
    "validBefore": now + 3600,
    "nonce": bytes.fromhex(nonce[2:]),
}

signable = encode_typed_data(full_message={"types": types, "primaryType": "TransferWithAuthorization", "domain": domain, "message": message})
signature = payer.sign_message(signable).signature.hex()

v2_payload = {
    "x402Version": 2,
    "accepted": {
        "scheme": "exact",
        "network": "eip155:8453",
        "amount": str(amount_units),
        "asset": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913",
        "payTo": "0x73279fa4BadA7CAC888c62CDa4f5c8104765f6f1",
        "maxTimeoutSeconds": 300,
        "extra": {"name": "USD Coin", "version": "2"}
    },
    "payload": {
        "signature": "0x" + signature if not signature.startswith("0x") else signature,
        "authorization": {
            "from": payer.address,
            "to": "0x73279fa4BadA7CAC888c62CDa4f5c8104765f6f1",
            "value": str(amount_units),
            "validAfter": "0",
            "validBefore": str(now + 3600),
            "nonce": nonce,
        }
    }
}

sig_header = base64.b64encode(json.dumps(v2_payload).encode()).decode()

resp = httpx.post(
    "https://stealthguard-402.onrender.com/v1/stealth_scrape_and_sanitize",
    json={"url": "https://example.com"},
    headers={"PAYMENT-SIGNATURE": sig_header}
)
print("Result:", resp.json())
```

---

## 4. MCP Server (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Desktop)
Add to your `claude_desktop_config.json` or `mcpServers`:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "stealthguard": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "stealthguard-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```
